Improves Windows crash diagnostics, English/Russian engineering dictation, and update size.

- **Copy debug report** includes versions, selected models, actual inference backends, recent stages and saved callstacks. Find it in the main window or **Settings → Diagnostics**, alongside **Open diagnostics folder**.
- Windows now saves managed exception stacks and native crash dumps locally. Microphone-stop errors and optional sound failures no longer escape the hotkey-release path. A crash report from an affected machine is still needed to identify its exact failure.
- Default editing instructions produce natural US engineering English, preserve code and existing emojis, use ASCII punctuation, and omit trailing periods in lists. Russian and English spoken corrections have examples. Existing custom prompts are preserved.
- Whisper's automatic language detection chooses between English and Russian and includes technical vocabulary.
- **Windows engines are downloaded once and shared across app updates**: approximately 13 MB for CPU, plus an optional 679 MB CUDA download on NVIDIA systems. Downloads are verified and work offline afterward. No Python, CUDA toolkit or external setup is required.

This is a stable release for **Windows x64, Apple silicon and Intel Macs**. Existing model selections remain unchanged. TranslateGemma remains a translation-only option; use Qwen for editing rules. Mac builds remain ad-hoc signed unless Developer ID signing/notarization is configured.

Crash diagnostics stay under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\TalkToMe\Diagnostics`. Text reports exclude dictation, audio and credentials; binary dumps may contain private process memory and are never uploaded automatically.
